labels.shown: Parsed installed data or decoded source; not observed gameplay

findings.label: inferred
findings.claim: The installed architecture supports regions within one setting, not independently simulated realms.
findings.limits: All twelve group definitions and core player/loader paths inspected; no runtime world travel tested.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: Ordinary action current levels reset on rebirth, retaining cycle/lifetime best. Generic Action uses 1 + cycle best / 10. Skill overrides the XP multiplier and Heroic Potential skips resets.
findings.limits: Do not apply generic multiplier to every skill or spell reset scope.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: Technologies persist across rebirth, normally clear on regression, and can later retain via a purchased permanence effect.
findings.limits: Public infrastructure fiction for YAIRPG is a proposal, not a direct source simulation of townspeople.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: Separate job and training slots progress alongside lifestyle effects; exploration suspends active work until concurrency is unlocked. Passive job income can continue.
findings.limits: Slots do not establish a conserved day budget or multiple world clocks.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: Offline load adds elapsed wall time and saved bank; the bank has no delta-based spend and is not consumed by the speed multiplier.
findings.limits: Static contradiction only; runtime efficacy, FPS and scene wiring not tested.

findings.label: stated
findings.claim: Offline popup promises a duration-based 2x speed benefit.
findings.limits: No script caller found for popup method; binary signal wiring unread; contradicted by inspected consumers.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: Birth age is fixed at 20 or 12 with Temporal Youth; baseline lifespan is 50, modified by named effects and boss day rewards.
findings.limits: No generated life trait/family seed found in inspected state, handlers, save or JSON field inventory.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: Live save is GZIP-compressed JSON encoded as base64, with version, player/content domains, reset scopes, automation, loadouts, clocks and preferences.
findings.limits: Actual user save/import/backup behavior not exercised; raw saves untouched.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: Resources are shared and reset-scoped. Temporal Essence has special regression award, lifetime learning bonus and allocation handling.
findings.limits: Resource descriptors include future categories; they are not all live player wallets.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: Age and exploration mortality cause death; Miracles can absorb exploration rolls; Press On is a purchased scoped route.
findings.limits: Mortality depends on update cadence; zero-danger denominator and speed scaling untested.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: Specified routes force regression on death until an end boss clears the flag, with confirmation and optional automation auto-accept.
findings.limits: Source intent and handler checks only; rendered warning and input flow open.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: The parser accepts OR groups with multiple requirements inside; nonlockable content caches many satisfied conditions by erasing them from working requirements.
findings.limits: Some negative individual checks are also erased; do not describe all prerequisites as simultaneously live.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: Diary milestones progressively expose statistics, loadouts, automation and speed controls.
findings.limits: Manual rebirth also has age/route requirements; no first-play timing established.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: Explorations retain separate life, regression and lifetime completion/timing records; repeat learning can reduce boss danger and lifetime rewards can extend lifespan.
findings.limits: Balance and attainable repeat rates unmeasured.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: All 75 JSON files parse, exposing 651 content rows; constructors use category/subgroup/ID maps. There is no registered realm category.
findings.limits: All tables inventoried; full balance/prose coverage not claimed.

findings.label: inferred
findings.claim: Ascension and Divinity descriptors are not evidence of a live third prestige layer in this build.
findings.limits: No handler, wallet or serializer found; developer future intent unresolved.

findings.label: shown
findings.claim: Detail popups show past best and applicable XP multiplier; manual reset shows essence sources; cards provide requirement and unlock signals.
findings.limits: UI wiring only; binary scenes and native rendering not inspected.

gaps.item: Rendered desktop UI and complete binary scene signal wiring
gaps.reason: No game launch authorized; 96 .scn and 55 .res files not converted.
Static code only; observed gameplay prohibited.

gaps.item: Full story prose and per-row balance/reachability
gaps.reason: All 75 tables inventoried; selected reset/unlock/effect rows traced, not every narrative or numeric combination.
Descriptors lack live consumer in inspected registry/state/handlers.
